items.title: Logic Pro 13 gets touch right, but stumbles on "intelligent assistant"
items.excerpt: Review of Apple's Logic Pro 13 public release: touch control lands well, but the new AI 'intelligent assistant' (now metered via Apple Creator Studio usage credits) stumbles in practice.

items.title: Apple's $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
items.excerpt: Instead of a subscription tier, Apple now sells $50 packs of extra AI usage credits for Creator Studio apps, including Logic Pro's AI assistant once the monthly limit is hit.

items.title: TubeTube, 가사·이야기 입력하면 15분 만에 AI 영상 완성…작곡부터 편집까지 자동화
items.excerpt: Korean AI video service TubeTube launches an integrated tool that turns lyrics or a story into a finished video in about 15 minutes, automating composition, vocals, storyboard, images and editing.

items.title: What BPB readers think about AI in music software
items.excerpt: Poll of 2,096 producers: 89% want some AI coverage, but 72% are a 'hard no' on text-to-music generators; useful AI tools with disclosure are the preferred approach.

history_match.title: BPB starts filtering low-quality AI-built plugins from its news, opens reader poll

items.title: Tuned launches its V2 vocal plugin bundle for $9.99 with "F*CK AI SLOP" campaign
items.excerpt: Tuned Plugins releases Vocal Essentials Bundle V2 under an explicitly anti-'AI slop' campaign, positioning hand-crafted DSP against hastily machine-generated plugins.

items.title: Waves Releases ILLUGEN 2.5
items.excerpt: Waves' AI text-to-sample generator ILLUGEN 2.5 arrives as a plugin version with deep Cubase 16 integration, generating one-shots and loops inside the DAW.

items.title: 5 Keys to Music Attribution
items.excerpt: AI music attribution promises fair payments to creators whose work trained generative models, but technical and economic hurdles of scale, rights and payment may still leave artists behind.

items.title: Human Enough? How AI Detector Scores Put Indie Artists at Risk
items.excerpt: Platforms can treat probabilistic AI-detector scores like verdicts; DMN looks at the data on how a '93% human' score can still put indie artists' releases at risk.

history_match.title: More AI Detector False Positives Emerge In Rapid Succession: Do Indie Musicians Have a Serious Problem Here?

items.title: Dr. Dre Says People Mad About AI "Aren't That Creative"
items.excerpt: Dr. Dre says he is enthusiastic about using AI in music-making and that the people angry about AI 'aren't that creative'.

items.title: The Edge asked AI to come up with a U2 song: "They couldn't"
items.excerpt: U2's The Edge says AI can write a codified country song, but attempts to have it generate a U2 song failed because the band's songwriting is 'never a formula'.

items.title: Grimes to Star in the First-Ever AI-Generated Film Coming to Theaters
items.excerpt: Grimes stars in 'Gods Don't Give Gifts', billed as the first fully AI-generated feature film to get a theatrical release; Billboard shares a clip of her character.

items.title: SPDMX: Large-Scale Open Stem Audio From Symbolic Music
items.excerpt: Researchers release a large open multitrack stem-audio dataset rendered from symbolic music, sidestepping copyright limits on redistributing training audio for music AI tasks.

items.title: Functional Dependency beyond Similarity: Hierarchical Decomposition of Training Data Attribution in Music Generative Models
items.excerpt: Proposes hierarchical training-data attribution for music generative models, estimating each training track's functional influence on outputs as a basis for copyright and royalty analysis beyond similarity.

items.title: Latent Terrain: Adapting Neural Audio Autoencoders as Design Materials in NIME
items.excerpt: Explores neural audio autoencoders as a sound-synthesis design material for new musical instruments, mapping latent spaces into playable 'terrains' for AI-enhanced instruments.
